title: GLua project configuration
description: Project-wide rules for the GLua language server. Committed to the repository, so they apply to everyone working on it.

severity.description: Severity to report at, or 'off' to disable the rule.

enable.description: Turn all diagnostics on or off.

undefinedGlobal.description: Reading a global that is neither a known GMod API member nor assigned anywhere in the workspace. Declare externals under 'globals' instead of turning this off.

realmViolation.description: Calling a serverside-only function from a clientside file, or vice versa.

deprecated.description: Use of API members the wiki marks deprecated.

argumentCount.description: Wrong number of arguments for a documented function.

argumentType.description: Argument whose inferred type cannot match the documented parameter.

unknownHook.description: hook.Add with a name that is neither documented nor fired in this workspace.

netMessage.description: Unregistered, unsent or unhandled net messages.

netReadWriteMismatch.description: net.Write sequence not matching the net.Read sequence in the handler.

missingAddCSLuaFile.description: Clientside file that is included but never sent with AddCSLuaFile.

globalWrite.description: Writing to a global instead of declaring a local.

duplicateIdentifier.description: Two hook.Add calls sharing an event and identifier, or two timer.Create calls sharing a name, in overlapping realms. The second silently replaces the first.

missingAsset.description: A material, model or sound path that does not exist. Off by default: it needs glua.workspace.gamePath, and only suits projects where every asset ships in the repository, since Workshop and content-pack assets cannot be seen from here.

scope.description: Whether to report problems only in open files, or in every indexed file.

$schema.description: URL of the JSON schema for this file.

diagnostics.description: Per-rule severities. Rules can also be suppressed inline with '-- glua-ignore <rule>'.

globals.description: Globals provided by addons outside this workspace, e.g. ["ULib", "ulx", "pac"]. Declaring them stops undefined-global firing on every use.

format.description: Formatting options. A .gluafmtrc.json file, if present, wins over this.

exclude.description: Directory names to skip while indexing.

libraries.description: Source trees for frameworks this project uses but does not contain (ULib, DarkRP, Wiremod). Indexed for what they define and never reported on. Absolute, or relative to this file.

overrides.description: Per-path rule overrides, applied in order; later entries win.

files.description: Glob patterns relative to this file's directory, e.g. lua/vendor/**.

globals.description: Extra globals for matching files only.
